name: Loamward
summary: Loamward is a sandbox game about working the land, played on your own or online with others. Players begin in the Loamwood forest and shape the world tile by tile: digging, flattening and paving the ground, felling trees, mining caves and ore veins, and building houses, walls and whole settlements from what they gather. Skills improve through use, and everything crafted carries a quality level set by the maker's skill, tools and materials. The game also includes farming, cooking with nutrition, smithing, carpentry, tailoring, fishing, creatures to hunt, tame and ride, and settlements founded and run by players.
